scope: Four fixed spatial architectures, one seed, H8 common starts0..92, shared Adam.003. Different hidden weights/shapes but common zero-readout identity; source-depth3 initialization bitwise preserved. U-Net/widerCNN approximately parameter matched, not otherwise identical. Same60s active-training limit, full100-frame validation, original independent architecture-specific FD gates. Preparation/compilation excluded from active budget but reported. Shared reference cache makes later per-arm total times asymmetric; whole multi-arm process is not a standalone T4 CI runtime. No test-based selection.
